Pharmaceutical Secondary Packaging Products

Purpose-engineered packaging solutions manufactured under ISO 9001:2015 and cGMP guidelines for regulated formulation plants.

SECONDARY PACKAGING

Folding Cartons

Precision-printed paperboard folding cartons engineered for automated high-speed packaging lines. Available in reverse tuck, crash lock, and custom dividers.

  • Reverse Tuck End (RTE) & Straight Tuck End (STE)
  • Auto-Bottom Crash Lock & Custom Partition Boxes
  • Suitable for solid orals, syrups, ointments, & parenterals

PATIENT INFORMATION

Leaf-inserts

Prescribing information leaflets (PIL) and patient instruction inserts folded to precise dimensions for automated cartoning line insertion.

  • Flat sheets, parallel folded, & cross-folded leaflets
  • Miniature folded outserts with sticker seals
  • 100% in-line sensor scanning during folding

CONTAINER LABELING

Printed Labels

High-precision self-adhesive roll labels for pharmaceutical bottles, vials, ampoules, and IV containers with serialization barcode compatibility.

  • Chromo paper, synthetic PE/PP, & metallic films
  • High-speed automated bottle application rolls
  • Barcodes, batch numbers, & 2D Data Matrix printing

PROTECTIVE PARTITIONS

Honeycomb Separators

Protective cardboard honeycomb dividers and grid partitions designed to safeguard glass ampoules and liquid vials against transit breakage.

  • High compression strength paperboard structure
  • Custom cell dimensions for parenteral shipping boxes

Pill-folders

Paperboard medicine packaging wallets with integrated dose-tracking calendar compartments engineered to support patient medication adherence.

Temper Evident Cartons & Labels

Destructible security seals and tamper-evident carton structures that provide immediate, irreversible visual evidence if packaging has been breached.

3D-ENGRAVIX™

Proprietary micro-structured optical security feature integrated directly onto folding cartons for instant visual authentication under ambient light.

  • Zero equipment, app, or scanner required
  • Micro-optic motion (spinning blade & light effects)
  • Flip effect & seal-base color shift verification

Cold-seal Wallet

Pressure-sealed (non-heat-sealed) paperboard blister packaging wallet encapsulating blister cards without applying heat to temperature-sensitive medicine.
